program:
app "Gym visits" dumbbell ocean
table gym
setting target num = 3
let n = count(gym today)
draw width 240 tap add gym
  circle 44 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 44, 0, 360 * clamp(n / target, 0, 1) stroke accent thick 8
  label 50, 46, n big
  label 50, 64, "of" target faint
stat streak(gym), "day streak"
daybars last 7 days, count(gym on it)
remind "Time for gym visits" every 2h from 9:00 to 21:00
describe:
Gym visits, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- gym: just the time of each entry. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: target: number, starts at 3.
Works out:
- n is how many gym entries today.
Shows:
- a drawing made of circles, arcs, labels; a tap adds a gym.
- a big number: the current day streak of gym entries, labelled "day streak".
- a bar chart of how many gym entries on that day for each day in the last 7 days.
Reminder "Time for gym visits" every 2 hours from 9:00 to 21:00.

fuller_style: one sentence of 14 to 22 words, mentions the most special feature first

program:
app "Bakery" bread plum
table product name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 5, kind pick Daily|Weekly|Rare

program:
app "Match Scores" ball ocean
table ball runs num 0..6 = 0, wide bool, out bool
setting overs num = 60
let legal = count(ball today where wide = no)
let runs = sum(ball.runs today) + count(ball today where wide = yes)
let wkts = count(ball today where out = yes)
runs "/" wkts big
"Overs" floor(legal / 6) + legal % 6 / 10 "of" overs faint
row gap 1
  each [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6]
    button it tap add ball runs = it
row gap 1
  button "Wide" tap add ball wide = yes
  button "Out" fill bad tap add ball out = yes
  button "Undo" tap remove last(ball today)
describe:
Match Scores, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- ball: runs: number, 0 to 6, starts at 0; wide: yes or no; out: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: overs: number, starts at 60.
Works out:
- legal is how many ball entries today where wide is no.
- runs is the total runs of ball today plus how many ball entries today where wide is yes.
- wkts is how many ball entries today where out is yes.
Shows:
- text: runs, "/", wkts.
- text: "Overs", legal divided by 6 rounded down plus legal leaves over when divided by 6 divided by 10, "of", overs.
- for 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6:
  - a button the value; a tap adds a ball with runs set to the value.
- a button "Wide"; a tap adds a ball with wide set to yes.
- a button "Out"; a tap adds a ball with out set to yes.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest ball entries today, with undo.

fuller_style: one long sentence of 18 to 30 words

program:
app "Box cards" brain plum
table card front text, back text, box num 1..3 = 1
state lvl num = 1
state flip bool = no
row gap 1
  each [1, 2, 3]
    button "Box" it fill if(lvl = it, accent, soft) tap set lvl = it
"Cards in this box" count(card where box = lvl) faint
each card where box = lvl sort at top 1 as c
  stack card gap 2 tap set flip = not flip
    if flip
      c.back big
    else
      c.front big
  row gap 1
    button "Know" tap set c.box = min(c.box + 1, 3) then set flip = no
    button "Miss" tap set c.box = 1 then set flip = no
form card, "Add card"
describe:
Box cards, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- card: front: text; back: text; box: number, 1 to 3, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: lvl, starting at 1; flip, starting at no.
Shows:
- for 1, 2, 3:
  - a button "Box", the value; a tap sets lvl to the value.
- text: "Cards in this box", how many card entries where box is lvl.
- for each card where box is lvl sorted by at, first 1:
  - a group; a tap sets flip to not flip:
    - if flip:
      - text: the back of the card.
    - otherwise:
      - text: the front of the card.
  - a button "Know"; a tap sets the box of the card to the smaller of the box of the card plus 1 and 3, then sets flip to no.
  - a button "Miss"; a tap sets the box of the card to 1, then sets flip to no.
- a form to add a card.

program:
app "Cricket match" ball ocean
table point team pick Eagles|Tigers, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Eagles)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Tigers)
setting winat num = 99 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Eagles" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Eagles, pts = 1
  stack card grow align center
    "Tigers" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Tigers, pts = 1
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
if a >= winat
  "Eagles win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Tigers win!" head color good
list point
describe:
Cricket match, in the ocean colours.

- point: team: one of Eagles, Tigers; pts: number, 1 to 500, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.

- text: "Eagles".

- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Eagles, pts set to 1.
- text: "Tigers".
- text: b.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Tigers, pts set to 1.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest point entries, with undo.
- a button "New game"; a tap removes all point entries, with one undo.
- text: "Lead:", a minus b without its sign.
- if a is at least winat:
  - text: "Eagles win!".
- if b is at least winat:
  - text: "Tigers win!".
- a list of point; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
